long_biography.plain_text:
Duff grew up working in Southern Tire Mart, the small Columbia, Mississippi, dealership his father Ernest established in 1973. When Thomas and James Duff took charge a decade later, the company was losing money. They restored it, sold the business and later bought it back, then expanded the tire dealership and retreading operation across the United States.

The brothers created Duff Capital Investors in 2007 as a holding company for their widening portfolio. Thomas remains a co-owner and active leader alongside James, not the sole owner of either enterprise. Their group now spans trucking, automotive retail, construction, energy, insurance, hospitality and real estate. Company revenue, property portfolios, vehicle fleets and reported transaction values belong to the relevant businesses or family ownership structures and are not measures of Thomas Duff's personal wealth.
